A1.justification: Both 40-page PDFs present the same SURGE study. All pages were extracted and rendered; pages 2–40, including appendices A–D, match in text and appearance. The first-page differences concern authorship and version information.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations of 21 LLMs in Section 4 and Appendix A, together with error analyses and training-scale experiments in Section 5.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the model evaluations in Tables 2 and 5 and the training-scale results in Figure 2.

M1.justification: The dataset-construction workflows, surrogate-execution prompting procedures, and supervised fine-tuning approach are unchanged in Sections 3–4 and appendices B–D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,160 problems across eight subsets: ML, CL, RL, SC, TC, BG, DR, and FL. No datasets, tasks, languages, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Section 4.1 and Tables 2 and 5 retain the same evaluated models and their participation in each prompting condition. No comparison method is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: The subset-specific metrics, three prompting conditions, temperature-zero decoding, model configurations, and training settings are identical in both versions.

E4.justification: Sections 4.3 and 5 retain the same anomaly cases, language and difficulty breakdowns, runtime and compilation-setting analyses, error analysis, and training-scale study.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout the text, tables, and figures. Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests relative to the other.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 2–5, plotted results in Figures 1, 2, 4, and 5, and qualitative findings are unchanged. The complete results in Appendix A also match.

T1.justification: The formal-language scoring definition in Section 3.3 and mathematical equations and metric definitions in Appendix C are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about SURGE, the evaluation of 21 LLMs, and the training-scale study. Contribution scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same explanations of prompting effects, model-size anomalies, computational boundaries, and error patterns. The limitations discussion is also identical.

D1.justification: Appendices B–D retain the same prompts, code examples, and Table 12 hyperparameters, and the benchmark access link is unchanged. Appendix C.8 retains the same placeholder directing readers to source code for FL details.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the scientific text, and the reference list are identical. The positioning relative to neural surrogate models and prior code-related research is unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 removes Qi-An Sun and Jiaming Zhang from the author line and updates the arXiv stamp from v4 dated 28 September 2025 to v5 dated 25 May 2026. The scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–12 retain identical content, styling, captions, and placement. The document layout is retained; first-page differences are confined to author and version text.

improvement.justification: v5 changes the author list and version information while retaining the scientific text, results, figures, and appendices unchanged. These edits provide no evidence of a meaningful gain or loss in the paper's clarity, empirical support, or reproducibility.
